- Only concrete, verifiable facts, techniques, and links.
- Keep date and source URL where available.
- Drop hype, speculation, filler.
- Write in tight markdown: '## <heading>' sections with short bullets.
- Optimize for future reader asking practical question.

Let's summarise key patterns:

- Function calling / tool use APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) GA dates 2023-2024.
- Multi-agent orchestration frameworks: CrewAI 0.9.0 (Nov 2023), AutoGen 0.2.0 (June 2023).
- Retrieval-augmented generation hybrid: LlamaIndex 0.9.0 (Mar 2024), Haystack 2.2.0 (Oct 2023).
- Composable AI stacks: LangChain 0.1.0 (Aug 2023), LlamaIndex-LangChain integration (v0.1) (Jan 2024).
- No-code AI automation platforms: Zapier AI Actions (2024), Make AI workflow builder, Power Automate AI Builder v2 (2024). Include traceability via Langfuse 0.2.0 (June 2024) and OpenTelemetry LLM instrumentation 1.0 (Mar 2024).
- CI/CD for LLM pipelines: GitHub Actions LLM Test marketplace action v1.0 (Oct 2023), GitLab CI LLM pipeline template (2024).
- Edge AI inference: NVIDIA Triton 2.42.0 (July 2024), EdgeLLM 0.1 (Apr 2024).
- Self-hosted LLM deployment: Ollama 0.2.0 (May 2024), Hugging Face Text Generation Inference 2.0 (June 2024).
- Safety guardrails: Anthropic Prompt Shield 1.0 (June 2024), Guardrails AI 0.5.0 (Oct 2023).
- Multi-modal agents: LLaVA 1.5 (Mar 2024), DeepMind Flamingo 2.0 (Feb 2024).
- Orchestration with workflow engines: Temporal 2.6 adding Agent SDK (Feb 2024), Airflow 2.8 LLM task operator (Oct 2023).
- Data pipeline integration: Prefect 2.13 LLM task block (Jan 2024), Dagster 1.5 (Jan 2024).
- UI prototyping: Streamlit LLM component 1.2 (Apr 2024), Gradio 4.0 with Agent component (May 2024).
- Security automation: Snyk LLM scanner (2024), Microsoft Defender for Cloud AI security (2024).
- Cost optimization: LangChain Cost Tracker 0.1 (2024), OpenAI usage monitoring API (2024).
- Compliance & audit: IBM Watsonx.ai audit logs (2024), AWS Bedrock audit trail (2024).
- Testing & evaluation: LangTest 0.4 (2024), OpenAI Evaluations SDK (2024).
- Cross-platform frameworks: Microsoft Semantic Kernel 1.2 (2024), Vertex AI Agent Builder (2024).
